import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Clean Ensembl IDs by stripping version suffixes
expr.index = expr.index.str.split(pat='.', n=1).str[0]

# 3. Map gene symbols to expected Ensembl IDs and detect availability
gene_map = {
    'LAG3': 'ENSG00000089626',    # expected but may be absent
    'TIGIT': 'ENSG00000136872',  
    'HAVCR2': 'ENSG00000135046'
}
available = {sym: gid for sym, gid in gene_map.items() if gid in expr.index}
missing = [sym for sym in gene_map if sym not in available]
print("Gene availability:")
for sym in available:
    print(f"  Found {sym} -> {available[sym]}")
for sym in missing:
    print(f"  Missing {sym}, will be excluded from analysis.")
if not available:
    raise ValueError("No target genes found in expression data. Analysis cannot proceed.")

# 4. Compute per-patient mean expression for available genes
expr_t = expr.T.copy()
expr_t['patient_id'] = expr_t.index.str[:12]
expr_by_patient = expr_t.groupby('patient_id').mean()
# Subset to available genes
df_expr = expr_by_patient[list(available.values())].reset_index()
# Rename columns to gene symbols
df_expr = df_expr.rename(columns={gid: sym for sym, gid in available.items()})

# 5. Prepare clinical data: filter for primary_site
df_clin = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'primary_site', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'clark_level']]
df_clin = df_clin[df_clin['primary_site'].isin(['Skin', 'Lymph nodes'])]
df_clin = df_clin.rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient_id'})

# 6. Merge clinical and expression data
df = pd.merge(df_clin, df_expr, on='patient_id', how='inner')
print(f"Merged dataset: {df.shape[0]} patients with expression and clinical data.")

# 7. Summary statistics by site and gene
genes = list(available.keys())
summary = []
for site, sub in df.groupby('primary_site'):
    stats = {'site': site, 'n': len(sub)}
    for gene in genes:
        stats[f'{gene}_mean'] = sub[gene].mean()
        stats[f'{gene}_median'] = sub[gene].median()
        stats[f'{gene}_std'] = sub[gene].std()
    summary.append(stats)
summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary)
print("\nGroup-wise expression summary:")
print(summary_df)

# 8. Wilcoxon rank-sum tests and BH correction
results = []
for gene in genes:
    data_skin = df[df['primary_site']=='Skin'][gene]
    data_ln = df[df['primary_site']=='Lymph nodes'][gene]
    stat, p = mannwhitneyu(data_skin, data_ln, alternative='two-sided')
    results.append((gene, stat, p))
gs, stats_vals, p_vals = zip(*results)
_, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests(p_vals, method='fdr_bh')
res_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'gene': gs,
    'statistic': stats_vals,
    'p_value': p_vals,
    'p_adj': p_adj
})
print("\nWilcoxon rank-sum test results with BH correction:")
print(res_df)

# 9. Violin plots with jittered points and p-values
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(genes), figsize=(6 * len(genes), 5))
if len(genes)==1:
    axes = [axes]
for ax, gene, p_adj_val in zip(axes, gs, p_adj):
    sns.violinplot(x='primary_site', y=gene, data=df, inner=None, ax=ax, palette='pastel')
    sns.stripplot(x='primary_site', y=gene, data=df, ax=ax, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
    ax.set_title(f'{gene} expression by site')
    ax.set_xlabel('Primary site')
    ax.set_ylabel('Expression')
    # annotate p-value
    ax.text(0.5, 0.95, f'adj p = {p_adj_val:.3e}', transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Clean Ensembl IDs by stripping version suffixes
expr.index = expr.index.str.split(pat='.', n=1).str[0]

# 3. Map gene symbols to expected Ensembl IDs and detect availability
gene_map = {
    'LAG3': 'ENSG00000089626',    # expected but may be absent
    'TIGIT': 'ENSG00000136872',  
    'HAVCR2': 'ENSG00000135046'
}
available = {sym: gid for sym, gid in gene_map.items() if gid in expr.index}
missing = [sym for sym in gene_map if sym not in available]
print("Gene availability:")
for sym in available:
    print(f"  Found {sym} -> {available[sym]}")
for sym in missing:
    print(f"  Missing {sym}, will be excluded from analysis.")
if not available:
    raise ValueError("No target genes found in expression data. Analysis cannot proceed.")

# 4. Compute per-patient mean expression for available genes
expr_t = expr.T.copy()
expr_t['patient_id'] = expr_t.index.str[:12]
expr_by_patient = expr_t.groupby('patient_id').mean()
# Subset to available genes
df_expr = expr_by_patient[list(available.values())].reset_index()
# Rename columns to gene symbols
df_expr = df_expr.rename(columns={gid: sym for sym, gid in available.items()})

# 5. Prepare clinical data: filter for primary_site
df_clin = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'primary_site', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'clark_level']]
df_clin = df_clin[df_clin['primary_site'].isin(['Skin', 'Lymph nodes'])]
df_clin = df_clin.rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient_id'})

# 6. Merge clinical and expression data
df = pd.merge(df_clin, df_expr, on='patient_id', how='inner')
print(f"Merged dataset: {df.shape[0]} patients with expression and clinical data.")

# 7. Summary statistics by site and gene
genes = list(available.keys())
summary = []
for site, sub in df.groupby('primary_site'):
    stats = {'site': site, 'n': len(sub)}
    for gene in genes:
        stats[f'{gene}_mean'] = sub[gene].mean()
        stats[f'{gene}_median'] = sub[gene].median()
        stats[f'{gene}_std'] = sub[gene].std()
    summary.append(stats)
summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary)
print("\nGroup-wise expression summary:")
print(summary_df)

# 8. Wilcoxon rank-sum tests and BH correction
results = []
for gene in genes:
    data_skin = df[df['primary_site']=='Skin'][gene]
    data_ln = df[df['primary_site']=='Lymph nodes'][gene]
    stat, p = mannwhitneyu(data_skin, data_ln, alternative='two-sided')
    results.append((gene, stat, p))
gs, stats_vals, p_vals = zip(*results)
_, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests(p_vals, method='fdr_bh')
res_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'gene': gs,
    'statistic': stats_vals,
    'p_value': p_vals,
    'p_adj': p_adj
})
print("\nWilcoxon rank-sum test results with BH correction:")
print(res_df)

# 9. Violin plots with jittered points and p-values
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(genes), figsize=(6 * len(genes), 5))
if len(genes)==1:
    axes = [axes]
for ax, gene, p_adj_val in zip(axes, gs, p_adj):
    sns.violinplot(x='primary_site', y=gene, data=df, inner=None, ax=ax, palette='pastel')
    sns.stripplot(x='primary_site', y=gene, data=df, ax=ax, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
    ax.set_title(f'{gene} expression by site')
    ax.set_xlabel('Primary site')
    ax.set_ylabel('Expression')
    # annotate p-value
    ax.text(0.5, 0.95, f'adj p = {p_adj_val:.3e}', transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}
